title: Nested encoding of six bit lists
statement: For bit lists $x,U,t,a,j,p$, define their encoding by pairing the encodings of $x$ and $U$ with the encoding of the pair consisting of the encoding of $t$ and $a$ and the encoding of $j$ and $p$, namely $\operatorname{pairEncode}(\operatorname{pairEncode}(x,U),\operatorname{pairEncode}(\operatorname{pairEncode}(t,a),\operatorname{pairEncode}(j,p)))$.
hypotheses_covered: Inputs $x,U,t,a,j,p$ are finite lists of Boolean values.
